context: A uni student and a teen friend talk about life decisions
purpose: Teach: 何故か/何となく/あいだ/あれこれ/とらえ/かえって/あて/いかなる

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: レンくん、最近何故か眠れなくてさ、将来のことあれこれ悩んでるんだ。
lines.en: Ren, lately for some reason I can't sleep, I keep worrying about all sorts of things about the future.
lines.style: Teen girl, casual confiding tone, slightly anxious but open with close friend.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: わかるよ。高校生のあいだはみんな何となく不安になるもんだよ。
lines.en: I get it. While you're in high school, everyone feels somewhat uneasy.
lines.style: University guy, warm reassuring older-brother vibe, relaxed and understanding.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 進路の話なんだけど、親はいかなる場合も安定した道を選べって言うの。
lines.en: About my career path, my parents say no matter what, choose the stable route.
lines.style: Teen girl, slightly frustrated, venting honestly about family pressure.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 親の言葉をそのままとらえると、かえって自分の本心が見えなくなるよ。
lines.en: If you take your parents' words at face value, ironically you lose sight of your true feelings.
lines.style: University guy, thoughtful advisor tone, gentle but firm with insight.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: でも、自分の感覚だけをあてにするのもちょっと怖いんだよね。
lines.en: But relying only on my own instincts is also a little scary.
lines.style: Teen girl, vulnerable and honest, voicing genuine self-doubt softly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 怖くて当然だよ。俺も大学の学科を選ぶとき、ずっと迷ってたから。
lines.en: It's natural to be scared. When I picked my university department, I was uncertain for ages too.
lines.style: University guy, empathetic and sharing personal experience to connect honestly.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: レンくんでも迷ったんだ?なんか聞いて少し安心したかも。
lines.en: Even you hesitated? Hearing that makes me feel a little relieved, somehow.
lines.style: Teen girl, lighter tone now, small smile in her voice.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 迷うのが普通だって。焦らず、自分のペースで決めればいいよ。
lines.en: Hesitating is normal. Don't rush, just decide at your own pace.
lines.style: University guy, calm closing reassurance, warm and steady supportive tone.
